definitions.explanation: {三|さん} plus the counter {回|かい}, used for repeated actions and occurrences. No sound change occurs: さん + かい stays さんかい.

examples.japanese: ⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧{三回|さんかい}⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: Take the medicine three times a day.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧{三回|さんかい}⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I've already seen this movie three times.

examples.japanese: ⟦{週|しゅう}→週：03204_shuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{三回|さんかい}⟦ジム→ジム：04735_jimu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}う→通う：01217_kayou⟧ようにして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧⟦{続|つづ}かない→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: I try to go to the gym three times a week, but I have trouble keeping it up.

notes:
⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧ + the general counter ⟦{回|かい}→回：00957_kai⟧ (times, occurrences).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{三回|さんかい}: three times a day
- ⟦{週|しゅう}→週：03204_shuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{三回|さんかい}: three times a week
- {三回|さんかい}⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧: the third time
- {三回|さんかい}{戦|せん}: the third round (of a tournament)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{三度|さんど}→三度：15154_sando⟧: three times — interchangeable in most contexts, and the usual choice in set phrases such as ⟦{三度|さんど}→三度：15154_sando⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧ (three meals a day)
- ⟦{三回忌|さんかいき}→三回忌：06019_sankaiki⟧: the second-anniversary memorial service — a fixed Buddhist term, counted differently from ordinary repetitions
